In this section we are going to learn about graph.
Graph is a non-linear data structure consists of nodes and edges.
The nodes are sometimes also referred as vertices, and the edges are lines or arcs that connect to
nodes in the graph.
So let's see what we mean by vertices and edges.
So here the circular objects that we have are vertices or nodes.

Graphs are used to solve many real life problems they use to represent the networks.
